author: bardic-inspiration
name: Ashen Greatsword
summary: A charred greatsword that explodes in a cloud of embers on a critical hit.
description: Pulled from a burned-out chapel by a mercenary who never explained what she was doing there. The blade smells of snuffed candles.

stats.effect: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you score a Critical Hit with it, ash and embers burst from the target; the target and each creature of your choice within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the {ref:condition/blinded} condition until the end of your next turn.
